body.name: Fully encoded polyhedral-label Gaussian experiments
body.construction: \(\mathfrak E=\{\mathfrak G=(d,V,\{\mathcal B_v,A_{v,b},b_{v,b},P_{v,b},D_v\}_{v,b},\Sigma,\delta,\eta,r):D_v=\bigcup_{b\in\mathcal B_v}P_{v,b}\text{ and }\mathfrak G\text{ satisfies }\text{ass:complete-label-cover},\text{ass:rational-positive-covariance},\text{ass:separated-domain-nonempty}\}\). The recession fan is the explicit homogeneous-arrangement construction \(\operatorname{recFan}(\mathfrak G)\), not an additional assumption.
